items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'I think his name Eddie Barrow' and describes his skills, but the interviewee (Benny Waters) does not respond or confirm any personal relationship.

ctx.x: Semi, semi, like my wife - he could play anything, read anything, and it had a little semi - he knew all of the songs and right harmony, see. I think his name Eddie Barrow, Barrow was his name, last name.
B-A-R-R-O-W (BW joins on last three letters) -
